mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 700K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 700K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signal a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both triggers are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94 signals decreased supply chain pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO < 94.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: positive GDP growth (GDPC1) signals sustained economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals inflationary pressure with accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when both triggers are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 8% signals labor market strength, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE < 8% during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: positive retail sales (RSAFS) growth signals sustained consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but with reduced effectiveness during post-shock recoveries.
regime_hint: any regime, reduced in post-shock recovery
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window during non-post-shock periods.
